clips.title: The story
paras: At the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, Kerlonian Evershade wakes from a long sleep in the Emerald Dream. The night elf Druid of the Claw needs help crossing the troubled wilds to reach Maestra's Post.

Kerlonian Evershade follows the bear totem as one of the Druids of the Claw. For centuries, these druids slept in barrows and communed with the Emerald Dream. They were called from their slumber during the Third War. Now Kerlonian rests beneath the ancient trees of the Grove of the Ancients, still shaking off the supernatural grogginess of his long sleep. He must travel through Darkshore's troubled forests to reach Maestra's Post on the Ashenvale border.

The road from the Grove of the Ancients is dangerous. Blackwood furbolgs prowl the Twilight Vale, while Dark Strand cultists lurk along the road into Ashenvale. Sleep has weakened Kerlonian, and sudden bouts of exhaustion still trouble him. He depends on sympathetic Alliance travelers for protection as he journeys south to rejoin his fellow night elves.
